local.description: Node-local ordinal, allocated by the owning registry.

Duration.description:
An elapsed time: integer ticks in a named clock domain (TM-1, TM-4 decision T4).

The domain tag is what stops 1 000 ticks at 20 Msps being added to a 200 MHz
point as a silent factor-of-ten error.

NodeId.description:
A node in the (future) multi-host deployment. `LOCAL` is the only legal value in v4.0.

Rule: X7 (`00-overview.md`); it qualifies every id of TM-11, SC-6, SB-3 and MA-19.

TimePoint.description:
An instant: integer ticks in a named clock domain. Never floating-point seconds.

There is deliberately no `PartialOrd`: two points of different domains cannot be
compared at all, and `a < b` silently answering `false` is the bug class this
model exists to prevent (decision T3).

Rule: TM-1, TM-6.

ticks.description: Tick count relative to the domain's origin; a sample index in a SampleClock (TM-10).

Validity.description: The window over which a [`ClockRelation`] may be applied (TM-14).

from.description: First instant, in the source domain, at which the relation holds.

to.description: Last instant, in the source domain; absent means the bound grows without limit.

description:
A measured relation between two roots: the only path between domains that are
not exactly related, and the record every Run carries from its root to `utc`.

`drift` and `drift_uncertainty` are the only floating-point quantities in the
time model, and neither reaches a stored `TimePoint` unrounded (TM-14, X9).

Rule: TM-5, TM-14, TM-18. Vision §24, §50.

drift.description:
Dimensionless: target seconds per source second, minus 1. Refused when
non-finite, because `serde_json` would otherwise write it as `null` and a
NaN drift would share a Manifest hash with one that was never measured
(OV-15, X9).

drift_uncertainty.description:
Dimensionless, non-negative: the one-sided error bound on `drift`. Zero
claims the drift is known exactly and is expected to be rare. Refused when
non-finite (OV-15, X9).

measured_at.description: When the measurement was taken, in the source domain.

method.description: Namespaced name of the measurement method, for example `dev.pps_poll`.

offset.description: The image of `measured_at` in the target domain.

uncertainty.description: The bound at `measured_at`, in target ticks, before drift error accumulates.

valid.description: The window over which the relation may be applied.

title: ClockRelation
